question: How many unique stock symbols exist in the dataset?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Symbol) RETURN count(DISTINCT s) AS answer

question: How many total records exist in the dataset?
cypher_query: MATCH (r:Record) RETURN count(r) AS answer

question: How many records are associated with the symbol AAPL?
cypher_query: MATCH (:Symbol {name:'AAPL'})<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r:Record) RETURN count(r) AS answer

question: How many distinct dates are present?
cypher_query: MATCH (d:Date) RETURN count(DISTINCT d) AS answer

question: How many symbols appear at least once?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(:Record) RETURN count(DISTINCT s) AS answer

question: What is the earliest date in the dataset?
cypher_query: MATCH (d:Date) RETURN min(d.value) AS answer

question: Does every record link to exactly one stock symbol?
cypher_query: MATCH (r:Record) WITH r, count { (r)-[:HAS_SYMBOL]->() } AS c WHERE c <> 1 RETURN count(r)=0 AS answer

question: Does every record link to exactly one date?
cypher_query: MATCH (r:Record) WITH r, count { (r)-[:HAS_DATE]->() } AS c WHERE c <> 1 RETURN count(r)=0 AS answer

question: Are there records linked to the same symbol on multiple dates?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r:Record)-[:HAS_DATE]->(d:Date) WITH s, count(DISTINCT d) AS c WHERE c>1 RETURN count(s)>0 AS answer

question: Are there symbols that appear only on a single date?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r:Record)-[:HAS_DATE]->(d:Date) WITH s, count(DISTINCT d) AS c WHERE c=1 RETURN count(s)>0 AS answer

question: Are there dates with records from more than one symbol?
cypher_query: MATCH (d:Date)<-[:HAS_DATE]-(r:Record)-[:HAS_SYMBOL]->(s:Symbol) WITH d, count(DISTINCT s) AS c WHERE c>1 RETURN count(d)>0 AS answer

question: Are there symbols missing records on at least one date?
cypher_query: MATCH (d:Date) WITH collect(d) AS allDates MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r:Record)-[:HAS_DATE]->(d:Date) WITH s, collect(DISTINCT d) AS ds, allDates WHERE size(ds) < size(allDates) RETURN count(s)>0 AS answer

question: Which symbols appear on every date in the dataset?
cypher_query: MATCH (d:Date) WITH collect(DISTINCT d) AS allDates MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r:Record)-[:HAS_DATE]->(d:Date) WITH s, collect(DISTINCT d) AS ds, allDates WHERE size(ds)=size(allDates) RETURN s.name AS answer

question: Which symbols appear on more than 5 distinct dates?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r:Record)-[:HAS_DATE]->(d:Date) WITH s, count(DISTINCT d) AS c WHERE c>5 RETURN s.name AS answer

question: Which symbols appear on the earliest date?
cypher_query: MATCH (d:Date) WITH min(d.value) AS md MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r:Record)-[:HAS_DATE]->(:Date {value:md}) RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS answer

question: Which symbols appear on the latest date?
cypher_query: MATCH (d:Date) WITH max(d.value) AS md MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r:Record)-[:HAS_DATE]->(:Date {value:md}) RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS answer

question: Which symbols appear on both the earliest and latest dates?
cypher_query: MATCH (d:Date) WITH min(d.value) AS minD, max(d.value) AS maxD MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r1:Record)-[:HAS_DATE]->(:Date {value:minD}) MATCH (s)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r2:Record)-[:HAS_DATE]->(:Date {value:maxD}) RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS answer

question: Which symbols appear on all but one date?
cypher_query: MATCH (d:Date) WITH collect(d) AS allDates MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r:Record)-[:HAS_DATE]->(d:Date) WITH s, collect(DISTINCT d) AS ds, allDates WHERE size(ds)=size(allDates)-1 RETURN s.name AS answer

question: Which dates contain records from all symbols?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Symbol) WITH collect(s) AS allSymbols MATCH (d:Date)<-[:HAS_DATE]-(r:Record)-[:HAS_SYMBOL]->(s:Symbol) WITH d, collect(DISTINCT s) AS ds, allSymbols WHERE size(ds)=size(allSymbols) RETURN d.value AS answer

question: Which symbols have the highest number of records?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r:Record) WITH s, count(r) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN s.name AS answer

question: Which symbols never appear on consecutive dates?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r:Record)-[:HAS_DATE]->(d:Date) WITH s, collect(d.value) AS ds RETURN s.name AS answer

question: Which symbols have records on more than half of all dates?
cypher_query: MATCH (d:Date) WITH count(DISTINCT d) AS total MATCH (s:Symbol)<-[:HAS_SYMBOL]-(r:Record)-[:HAS_DATE]->(d:Date) WITH s, count(DISTINCT d) AS c, total WHERE c > total/2 RETURN s.name AS answer
